sources.title: How to Use OPUS-MT for Multilingual to English Translation
sources.snippet: Step-by-step guide to implementing OPUS-MT Multilingual to English in Python. Learn setup, inference, and batch processing for global NLP projects.

sources.title: GitHub - Helsinki-NLP/Opus-MT: Open neural machine translation models ...
sources.snippet: There is a Makefile for training new models from OPUS data in the Opus-MT-train repository, but this is heavily customized for the work environment at CSC and the University of Helsinki projects. This will (hopefully) be more generic in the future to be able to run in different environments and setups as well.
